messages:
maria (People Ops): FYI — Alex Chen submitted resignation this morning. Last day 2026-04-15. Need to coordinate benefits end date, COBRA notice, laptop return, and access revocation.

devin (Manager): Thanks Maria. Confirming 4/15 as final day. Would like to schedule a 1pm exit interview on 2026-04-14 — People Ops can you set that up?

maria (People Ops): Will do. Payroll — any required docs to trigger final paycheck and PTO payout?

payroll (Payroll): Please approve final timesheet by 2026-04-13. PTO payout processed in next payroll run after termination. COBRA packet mailed/e‑mailed within 14 days of termination — we need a forwarding address on file.

alex (Employee): Address: 123 Maple Ave, SF CA 94107. I will submit/approve timesheet today.

it-support (IT): Noted. Proposed plan: suspend Okta/Google on 2026-04-15 at 09:00 PT. Do you want immediate suspension or end-of-day?

devin (Manager): Block prod console access ASAP on last day, but keep GitHub access until exit interview completes.

security (Security): We'll revoke production roles at 09:00 PT on 2026-04-15. Please list any shared service accounts/credentials Alex has.

maria (People Ops): Alex — please return the ThinkPad + dongles to L3 reception by 2026-04-16. If you need a courier, we can provide a prepaid label (expenses reimbursed).

alex (Employee): I'll drop it at reception 4/15 around noon. If I need to ship, please send label.

maria (People Ops): We'll send label if you request.

it-support (IT): For audit, we'll run these ops on the scheduled times: 

```
okta-cli suspend-user --email alex@redwood.ai --date 2026-04-15T09:00:00-07:00
aws iam detach-user-policy --user-name alex
remove-github-access alex --org redwood-ai
```

devin (Manager): Also flagging a few external tool owners: Sentry, DataDog, Mixpanel. Please transfer ownership or revoke by 4/15.

devex (Developer Experience): I'll take Sentry ownership. Alex, can you add emily@redwood.ai as a co-owner before 4/15?

alex (Employee): Done — added emily to Sentry and Datadog dashboards.

people-ops-bot: Exit interview scheduled: 2026-04-14 13:00 PT (Zoom link sent).

maria (People Ops): Quick final checklist that I'll track: 
- Payroll: final pay + PTO payout
- COBRA: packet within 14 days of termination
- IT: suspend prod roles 2026-04-15 09:00 PT, disable full account EOD 2026-04-15
- Assets: laptop return by 2026-04-16 (or prepaid courier)
- Manager: project handover notes in #eng-runtime

devin (Manager): I'll post handover in #eng-runtime by EOD 2026-04-12 and leave notes on outstanding tickets.

maria (People Ops): Alex — do we have a forwarding email for COBRA docs? Required to send paperwork.

alex (Employee): Yes — alex.chen+alumni@gmail.com

maria (People Ops): Great, I'll update payroll. Closing loop here — ping if anything changes. :thumbsup:
